import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f10 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0010.png').convert('RGB'))

# Plant 1 pot (near)
# Pot is terracotta brown/orange:
pot_mask = (f10[:, :, 0] > 140) & (f10[:, :, 1] > 60) & (f10[:, :, 1] < 120) & (f10[:, :, 2] < 70)
# Let's find plant 1 pot vs plant 2 pot
# Plant 1 is near, pot center is in x in 500..600? Wait, x is around 550? No, image is 512 wide.
# Let's see pot components
from scipy.ndimage import label
lbl, num = label(pot_mask)
print('Number of pot components in f10:', num)
for i in range(1, num+1):
    y, x = np.where(lbl == i)
    print(f'Pot {i}: size={len(y)}, x in [{x.min()}, {x.max()}], y in [{y.min()}, {y.max()}], bottom_y={y.max()}, center_x={np.mean(x):.1f}')
""}
